description: This file contains the implementation of Smarty internal compile classes for handling the {foreach}, {foreachelse}, and {/foreach} template tags within the Smarty templating engine. It defines classes responsible for compiling these tags into PHP code that performs iterating over data structures within templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Foreach
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {foreach} tag in Smarty templates, transforming it into PHP code that loops over a provided array.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Foreachelse
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {foreachelse} tag, which is used as an else clause within a foreach loop.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Foreeachclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {/foreach} closing tag, finalizing the loop.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method in each class that compiles the respective Smarty template tag into PHP code.

methods.name: compileRestore
methods.description: Restores template variables after loop completion (specific to Smarty_Internal_Compile_Foreach).
